$comment: FINAL OPERATOR DECISION PACKAGE (prepared in Mission 1.85.7). Facts behind the operator's three decisions, rendered from committed artifacts. The decisions live in the operator-owned decisions file; decision_state only mirrors it. Rendering decides nothing, and neither recording a decision nor merging authorises a provider call.
composition_consequence: NEGATIVE_EVALUATION_OF_NAMED_SOLUTION has no PRESENT cell in the single-human reference, so it cannot satisfy a minimum-PRESENT composition requirement and cannot provide meaningful positive-class recall in this pilot. That is not a model failure; PILOT_INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT is a valid outcome, and no threshold is weakened to avoid it.

A_pilot_thresholds.label: NEGATIVE_EVALUATION_OF_NAMED_SOLUTION
A_pilot_thresholds.why: a false PRESENT writes a dissatisfaction nobody expressed into a counting dimension
A_pilot_thresholds.can_measure: how many of the model's PRESENT calls on this label the one human did not mark PRESENT, and the Clopper-Pearson upper bound on that rate
A_pilot_thresholds.cannot_establish: a certified false-PRESENT rate, which needs adjudicated gold and holdout
A_pilot_thresholds.current_support: reference PRESENT 0, ABSENT 45, UNCERTAIN 1 over 46 approved records; the bound needs at least 30 PRESENT predictions, and with 0 reference PRESENT every PRESENT prediction would count as a false PRESENT
A_pilot_thresholds.expected_result: PILOT_INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT is the likely outcome unless the model makes at least 30 PRESENT calls

A_pilot_thresholds.label: REPORTED_FAILED_ATTEMPT
A_pilot_thresholds.why: a false PRESENT asserts a failure the asker did not report
A_pilot_thresholds.can_measure: the false-PRESENT rate among the model's PRESENT calls against the one human's cells, with its upper bound
A_pilot_thresholds.cannot_establish: a certified rate against adjudicated gold or on holdout
A_pilot_thresholds.current_support: reference PRESENT 15, ABSENT 29, UNCERTAIN 2 over 46 approved records; the bound needs at least 15 PRESENT predictions
A_pilot_thresholds.expected_result: any of the three pilot readings; depends on how many PRESENT calls the model makes

A_pilot_thresholds.label: each extractable label
A_pilot_thresholds.why: a classifier that always answers ABSENT, always PRESENT or always abstains must not pass
A_pilot_thresholds.can_measure: whether the model finds at least one PRESENT and one ABSENT the human also marked, per label
A_pilot_thresholds.cannot_establish: anything about labels the reference has no PRESENT for
A_pilot_thresholds.current_support: REPORTED_FAILED_ATTEMPT has 15 PRESENT and 29 ABSENT; NEGATIVE_EVALUATION_OF_NAMED_SOLUTION has 0 PRESENT, so its true-PRESENT half cannot be satisfied in this pilot
A_pilot_thresholds.expected_result: PILOT_INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT for NEGATIVE_EVALUATION_OF_NAMED_SOLUTION by construction; either reading for REPORTED_FAILED_ATTEMPT

A_pilot_thresholds.label: all
A_pilot_thresholds.why: an accepted quote that is not in the surface would be a validator defect
A_pilot_thresholds.can_measure: accepted findings whose quote is not the surface text at the computed offsets
A_pilot_thresholds.cannot_establish: semantic support, which needs a human reading
A_pilot_thresholds.current_support: needs no reference; 46 records would be attempted

A_pilot_thresholds.label: all
A_pilot_thresholds.why: a refusal is a failure, never an abstention
A_pilot_thresholds.current_support: needs no reference; 46 records attempted against a minimum of 20

A_pilot_thresholds.label: all
A_pilot_thresholds.why: abstention is benign but must not replace answering
A_pilot_thresholds.can_measure: how often the model abstains on records the one human decided
A_pilot_thresholds.cannot_establish: that the human's decided records are decidable for another reader
A_pilot_thresholds.current_support: records the human decided (not UNCERTAIN): REPORTED_FAILED_ATTEMPT 44, NEGATIVE_EVALUATION_OF_NAMED_SOLUTION 45; minimum 20

A_pilot_thresholds.label: each extractable label
A_pilot_thresholds.why: a result that changes on re-run cannot be audited
A_pilot_thresholds.can_measure: nothing in one run: it compares repeated runs
A_pilot_thresholds.current_support: requires 3 pinned runs; the current packet and ceiling cover one run with at most one schema retry per record, and the budget is NOT doubled automatically
A_pilot_thresholds.expected_result: PILOT_INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT for a single run; see repeatability_disposition

A_pilot_thresholds.label: each extractable label, each split
A_pilot_thresholds.why: a split without enough of both states cannot test anything
A_pilot_thresholds.can_measure: whether the one human's cells hold at least 4 PRESENT and 4 ABSENT per label
A_pilot_thresholds.cannot_establish: a gold composition, which needs adjudication
A_pilot_thresholds.current_support: REPORTED_FAILED_ATTEMPT 15 PRESENT / 29 ABSENT (met); NEGATIVE_EVALUATION_OF_NAMED_SOLUTION 0 PRESENT / 45 ABSENT (not met)
A_pilot_thresholds.expected_result: REFERENCE_SET_INSUFFICIENT for NEGATIVE_EVALUATION_OF_NAMED_SOLUTION in this pilot

A_pilot_thresholds.label: each extractable label
A_pilot_thresholds.why: descriptive only; conservative misses are tolerated
A_pilot_thresholds.can_measure: the share of the one human's PRESENT cells the model also marks PRESENT
A_pilot_thresholds.cannot_establish: recall against gold; for a label with no reference PRESENT, anything at all
A_pilot_thresholds.current_support: REPORTED_FAILED_ATTEMPT 15 reference PRESENT; NEGATIVE_EVALUATION_OF_NAMED_SOLUTION 0, so positive-class recall is UNDEFINED there

A_pilot_thresholds.label: all
A_pilot_thresholds.why: cost is bounded by the accepted ceiling; latency is recorded, never quality

proposed_reading: at most ONE retry per record
retry ONLY when the forced-tool payload is missing, is not valid against the strict schema, or is structurally incomplete
no retry on a deterministic validator refusal of a schema-valid payload
no retry on a provider or network error
no retry because a schema-valid semantic answer appears wrong
inside_the_retry_class: the gateway raises SchemaValidationError: no tool_use payload, or one failing the strict schema
a required key such as extraction_state or findings is missing
a finding object lacks a required field
outside_the_retry_class: a schema-valid payload whose quote is not in the surface (validator refusal)
a payload whose extraction_state disagrees with its findings, refused by the validator
HTTP 400/429/5xx, a timeout or a connection error
stop_reason max_tokens (output limit reached) or a refusal
a schema-valid answer the operator believes is semantically wrong
B_retry.implemented_as: sros_semantic_extraction.may_retry: only AttemptOutcome.SCHEMA_FAILURE with 0 retries used is retried
B_retry.cost_consequence: the retry worst case (every record retried once) is covered by the proposed ceiling

token_estimation_methodology.measured: exact UTF-8 bytes of each of the 46 request bodies, built offline by the runner's own prompt, strict tool and body builder (docs/data/semantic-extraction-request-size-development-v1.json)
token_estimation_methodology.no_local_tokenizer: NOT_PUBLISHED: token counts come from the token-counting endpoint, which would transmit the text, and are documented as estimates
token_estimation_methodology.conservative_input_tokens_per_call: request body bytes + 474 documented tool-use system prompt tokens + 2000 policy allowance for the undocumented strict prompt; counting a byte as a token over-counts English text and code, and two real strict requests in this repository reported about 0.40 tokens per character
token_estimation_methodology.multiplier: the US-only 1.1x is applied because inference_geo is not sent and the workspace default is not observable
token_estimation_methodology.ceiling_rule: retry worst case + one call at the documented maximum (full context window and the runner's output bound), rounded up to a whole dollar

enforcement.preflight: the runner refuses before any transport if the accepted ceiling is below retry worst case + one documented-maximum call
enforcement.before_each_call: including a retry: refused if spent + one documented-maximum call would exceed the accepted ceiling
enforcement.accumulation: each HTTP 200 adds its reported usage at the verified prices and multiplier; any call without reported usage is charged at the documented maximum
enforcement.estimate_check: a call whose reported input tokens exceed that record's conservative bound stops the run, fail-closed
